title: redteam.py open re-lists defects no red-team run can fix, so step 0 is a re-read every run
problem: Step 0 of prompts/redteam/prompt-0.md asks each run to fix every entry `redteam.py open` lists. One of the two left (help-keeper stemmer) waits on a help-center eval set that does not exist, so every run re-read it and moved on; the other still said 'control plane, own PR, owner approval', which stopped applying on 2026-11-24, so runs read it as unworkable too.
evidence: python3 platform/ci/friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 3, 2026-11-26: cluster 4, 5 sessions on prompts/redteam/prompt-0.md (2026-11-23..26)
prompts/runs/2026-11-25-*.json and 2026-11-26-*.json: 8 doc_friction entries asking for a blocked/parked state or noting the stale owner-approval wording
change: Real-defect entries may carry `blocked: "<what the fix needs>"`; `open` lists those on one line apart and leaves them out of the fix-first count. The help-keeper entry is marked blocked. Step 0 says the owner-approval wording no longer blocks a fix.
metric: Run-record doc_friction entries on prompts/redteam/prompt-0.md about step 0's open list being unactionable, per 7 days after merge
